description: How riders, drivers, business admins, and fleet operators relate to each other: who requests and serves trips, how fares and payouts move, and which rating and program loops keep the marketplace healthy.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Provisioning ride programs and supplying vehicles and drivers

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Requesting, matching, and completing trips day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Fares, payouts, central billing, and vehicle settlements

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Ratings, trip visibility, and program reporting

relations.name: Requests trips matched by the platform
relations.description: Requests rides that the marketplace matches to nearby drivers, who accept, pick up, and complete the trip against a quoted ETA and fare.

relations.name: Pays fares that fund driver payouts
relations.description: Pays the trip fare through in-app checkout; the platform takes its fee and settles the remainder to the driver as earnings and tips.

relations.name: Rates trips and drivers
relations.description: Rates each completed trip and driver, feeding the quality scores that influence driver standing and future matching.

relations.name: Rates rider behavior
relations.description: Rates riders after each trip so problematic behavior is visible to future drivers and to marketplace safety controls.

relations.name: Provisions business ride profiles
relations.description: Enrolls employees as riders under a company travel program with policy rules, allowed trip types, and expense-free billing.

relations.name: Charges work trips to central billing
relations.description: Books in-policy work trips against the company's central account, which the admin reviews and settles on a consolidated invoice.

relations.name: Leases vehicles and onboards drivers
relations.description: Supplies leased or rented vehicles to drivers and onboards them onto the platform under the fleet's account and standards.

relations.name: Settles vehicle costs from earnings
relations.description: Pays weekly vehicle rental and fleet fees, deducted from platform earnings before payout reaches the driver.

relations.name: Schedules supply for peak demand
relations.description: Plans driver shifts and positions fleet vehicles at airports and high-demand zones so drivers are online where trips are.
